Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) providing attackers full control over infected PCs, including recording video, sound, taking screenshots, stealing passwords; sold online mainly via HackForums.net and luminosity.link website; used for illegal purposes by some customers; attackers used it to infiltrate and exploit systems remotely
Attack Vector: Sold and distributed online via HackForums.net forum and luminosity.link website
Indicators of Compromise: Bitcoin transactions linked to LuminosityLink payments
Data recovered from reseller's PC in Bristol
